DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL(
				ROLLUPGROUP(
					'Data Quality Checks'[CheckName],
					'Data Quality Checks'[Severity],
					'Data Quality Checks'[Layer],
					'Data Quality Checks'[Scope],
					'Data Quality Checks'[Status],
					'Data Quality Checks'[IsEvaluated],
					'Data Quality Checks'[PassRate],
					'Data Quality Checks'[LastEvaluatedAtUtc]
				), "IsGrandTotalRowTotal"
			),
			"DQ_Failed_Rows", '_Measures'[DQ Failed Rows]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(
			502,
			__DS0Core,
			[IsGrandTotalRowTotal],
			0,
			'Data Quality Checks'[CheckName],
			1,
			'Data Quality Checks'[Severity],
			1,
			'Data Quality Checks'[Layer],
			1,
			'Data Quality Checks'[Scope],
			1,
			'Data Quality Checks'[Status],
			1,
			'Data Quality Checks'[IsEvaluated],
			1,
			'Data Quality Checks'[PassRate],
			1,
			'Data Quality Checks'[LastEvaluatedAtUtc],
			1
		)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed
